payload.title: A stale WAKE_SPACE pinned the deployment to a directory-named space

payload.reason: Fixed: WAKE_HOME wins, so the volume self-heals to spaces/wake on boot, and container unix users are no longer used as a display name.

payload.text: Correction: first written up as a leftover variable in the hosting dashboard. It was not — the ENV came from our own Dockerfile and was removed in the spaces commit. A running instance keeps it only until it is redeployed.
